_comment: A compilation album where the middle track carries NO `artist` tag and the last
carries no `title` — routine on rips and bootlegs. useSubsonic.ts:76-78 coalesces
both to null and every render site reads them through `?? ""`, so the TypeScript
shows blank text and keeps going.
The point of this fixture is the SIBLINGS: serde rejects the whole Vec if one
element fails, so requiring these fields would make one untagged track fail the
entire album page. All three songs must come through.

album.name: Now That's What I Call Untagged
album.album: Now That's What I Call Untagged

song.title: Properly Tagged Opener
song.album: Now That's What I Call Untagged
